<subject>GRIDOPS/NET AVAILABILITY</subject>
<body>
To all GRIDOPS users:

The GRIDOPS platform will be taken offline nightly between 00:01 and 04:00 CET for system maintenance.  
It will be accessible again by 05:30, with grid data updated and ready for the morning shift.

NET services will remain operational during this window.

Please contact the GRIDOPS Hotline (+49 171 373 5700) with any questions or issues.
</body>
